LAME in Ripple
==============

Ripple uses LAME 3.100 (https://lame.sourceforge.io/) to make MP3 files.
LAME is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2 or later. The licence text is in
LICENSE-LAME.txt, next to this file.

LAME is a separate library, Contents/Frameworks/libmp3lame.0.dylib inside the app. Ripple loads it when it runs.
You may replace it with another build of LAME (same file name, compatible interface). Replacing a file inside the app
breaks the app's signature, so sign the app again afterwards:

  codesign --force --deep --sign - /path/to/Ripple.app

(Ripple's own tests did exactly this with a differently built LAME, and the app kept working.)

Source
------
LAME 3.100: https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/lame/lame/3.100/lame-3.100.tar.gz
SHA-256: ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e

How this copy was built
-----------------------
From that source, unmodified, using every libmp3lame/*.c file except mpglib_interface.c (so there is no decoder), the
header vector/lame_intrin.h, and the config.h below. Command (tools/build-lame.sh):

  clang -arch arm64 -O3 -dynamiclib -w -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -I<dir> -I<dir>/include <dir>/*.c \
        -install_name @rpath/libmp3lame.0.dylib -o libmp3lame.0.dylib

config.h
--------
/* Minimal config for building LAME 3.100's encoder (libmp3lame) on macOS. */
#ifndef LAME_CONFIG_H
#define LAME_CONFIG_H

#define STDC_HEADERS 1
#define HAVE_STRCHR 1
#define HAVE_MEMCPY 1
#define HAVE_LIMITS_H 1
#define HAVE_STDINT_H 1
#define HAVE_INTTYPES_H 1
#define HAVE_ERRNO_H 1
#define HAVE_FCNTL_H 1
#define HAVE_UNISTD_H 1
#define HAVE_SYS_TIME_H 1
#define HAVE_STRINGS_H 1
#define HAVE_STRING_H 1
#define HAVE_MEMORY_H 1
#define HAVE_STDLIB_H 1
#define HAVE_SYS_STAT_H 1
#define HAVE_SYS_TYPES_H 1
#define TAKEHIRO_IEEE754_HACK 1
#define USE_FAST_LOG 1
#define SIZEOF_DOUBLE 8
#define SIZEOF_FLOAT 4
#define SIZEOF_INT 4
#define SIZEOF_LONG 8
#define SIZEOF_LONG_DOUBLE 8
#define SIZEOF_SHORT 2
#define SIZEOF_UNSIGNED_INT 4
#define SIZEOF_UNSIGNED_LONG 8
#define SIZEOF_UNSIGNED_SHORT 2
#define PACKAGE "lame"
#define VERSION "3.100"

typedef float ieee754_float32_t;
typedef double ieee754_float64_t;

#endif
